research_period: Milan, Paris and Pitti Uomo menswear shows, June 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Formalwear Styling
summary: Formal SS27 menswear: the lighter suit with an open neck, monochrome black suits, leather suiting and tuxedos cut for both men and women.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Designers broadly agreed that a well-dressed man still wears a suit, but lighter, with open necklines and unbuttoned or transparent shirts<sup>[1]</sup>. Paris showed black suits with matching trousers and monochrome dressing at Celine, IM Men and Valette Studio<sup>[2]</sup>. Saint Laurent used beige leather for suits<sup>[3]</sup>. At couture, Elie Saab cut tuxedos and capes for women as well as men<sup>[4]</sup>.

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Light suit + open-neck shirt + loafers.**
- **Black suit + black shirt, no tie.**
- **Beige or camel leather jacket + matching trousers.**
- **Seersucker suit + knit polo.**
- **Tuxedo jacket + satin shirt for evening.**

design_implications: - Shirts designed to be worn open: collar that holds its shape without a tie.
commercial_implications: - Offer suits as separates; summer weights lead.
